blender.description: Live Blender: run bpy Python, inspect the scene, render previews, import or generate 3D assets. Needs Blender open with the MCP for Blender addon running.

figma.description: Figma Dev Mode: read selected frames and nodes, variables and design tokens, screenshots, code from designs. Needs Figma Desktop with the Dev Mode MCP server enabled.

shadcn.description: shadcn component registries, including React Bits (@react-bits, animated React components): browse, search, view and get install commands for components of the project. Starts in the session's project; React Bits needs "registries": {"@react-bits": "https://reactbits.dev/r/{name}.json"} in the project's components.json. Needs Node (npx) and network.

motion.description: Motion (formerly Framer Motion) free docs server: search-motion-docs for current Motion API, guides and examples. Use together with the `motion` skill. Remote https://mcp.motion.dev, no key.

context7.description: Context7: current, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks (resolve-library-id, then get-library-docs / query-docs). Remote https://mcp.context7.com/mcp, no key; needs network.

codebase-memory.description: codebase-memory-mcp: a code knowledge graph of the project (index the repository, search symbols, trace callers and callees, architecture overview). Needs the codebase-memory-mcp binary installed and on PATH; without it, use grep/read.
